in_marathi.name: Bharath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountainous, or Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bharath is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bharam', which means 'to bear'. The name Bharath is associated with the epic Mahabharata, where Bharatha is the name of one of the two principal Pandava brothers. Another meaning is 'mountainous' or 'Lord of the Earth'.
